title: Reuse validated source report within proposal assessment
body:
Avoid repeating source benchmark comparison within one assessProposal call while preserving exact output and validation behavior. Static inspection identified three comparisons where two suffice.

Extract a private summarizeValidatedReport helper. Public analyzeHistory still validates using compareBenchmark. assessProposal passes its already validated local source report to the helper. No cross-call cache or trusted imported reports.

Risks: Measured latency is scoped to 30 assessments of pinned fixtures, including process startup. Five repetitions do not establish general performance or statistical significance. Hashes and profile execution are locally attested.

Rollback: Keep original source unchanged until approval; restore its pinned preimage if an approved future change needs rollback.
requirements: Authenticate reviewer outside this local library
Review target/change relevance and actual diff
Create PR only with explicit user authority; no merge or deployment implied
